Two Convicted in Rape Case, Sentenced to 20 Years Each

A court in Hisar has sentenced two individuals to 20 years of rigorous imprisonment each for the rape of a 14-year-old girl. The court also imposed a fine of ₹1.5 lakh on one of the convicts. The incident reportedly took place in Chandigarh.
